Game Overview

Block Breaker is a arcade game built around smash through block challenges with precision in Block Breaker. Navigate your paddle to keep the ball airborne, shatter dynamic block patterns, and seize special power-ups. Overcome 150 intricate levels that escalate in difficulty, offering relentless arcade excitement and strategy at every turn. Can you perfect the art of anticipation?
